smoke.notes: tidepool suite runs fully offline on mocks: 'tide-pool smoke: 18 passed, 0 failed' + node:test 13/13 pass (98ms) covering JEV gate floor refusal, sigma agreement mass, fail-closed on malformed JEV input, gate-off default bit-identity. Syntax checks on other subprojects not needed (no standalone runners). Path is inside the my-project workspace repo (toplevel /home/z/my-project, HEAD c20c1c8); no nested .git.

essence: fleet infrastructure as one monorepo of lanes: a shared context ocean, edge quilt runtimes, AI cells, canon headers

ideas.name: the shared context ocean
ideas.statement: Every agent's context window is a tide pool that drains each session; tidepool is the ocean behind it — WRITE at task end (distill <=200 words, fire-and-forget), READ at task start (recall-prime top 3), absence is information.

ideas.name: honest degrade as law
ideas.statement: Unbound bindings report themselves in /health and route responses — degrade honest, never 502; unlabeled artifacts are distrusted; absence of measurement is stated, not papered over.

ideas.name: a conscience on the recall path
ideas.statement: Recall can carry a schema-bounded JEV gate: every scored row gets a typed decision {surface|suppress|abstain, confidence, reasons}, certified by sigma = sqrt(c_emb * c_jev), below-floor pairings refuse as typed abstain, and off-by-default responses are bit-identical to the ungated pool.

ideas.name: the same cell model at every tier
ideas.statement: One abstraction deployed three ways — quilt on Cloudflare's edge (Workers/D1/Vectorize/KV), AI as first-class cell kinds across 4 providers with a router that spends only when it must, and the agent itself as a sheet (memory=value cells, tools=api cells, reasoning=program cells).

ideas.name: coordination by canon, not meetings
ideas.statement: Each lane declares itself in a CANON.md front-matter (mission, family, vessel, feeds, owed_by, verified date) and the monorepo groups five sub-fleets under one HEAD — the organizational substrate is files with declared debts and feeds.

ideas.name: prove the substrate everywhere
ideas.statement: Polyformalism: the same fnv1a primitive is proven identical across Python, C, Rust (plus Haskell/Mercury ports) — a receipt that the fleet's hash-basis is language-independent, backed by a fully mocked offline test suite.

parts.name: monorepo of fleet lanes
parts.essence: Five subprojects under one repo — tidepool (shared memory), quilt-cloudflare (edge runtime), jev-quilt (Python JEV engine + polyform ports), quilt-ai (AI cells), quilt-agent (agent-as-sheet) — infrastructure and coordination live together.
parts.failure_mode: divergent copies of the cell model across lanes
parts.evidence: si-fleet/ directory listing (tidepool/, quilt-cloudflare/, jev-quilt/, quilt-ai/, quilt-agent/)

parts.name: tidepool dual-index stores
parts.essence: Cloudflare D1 journal for artifacts + two Vectorize indexes: 16-dim 'native' domain fingerprint and 768-dim BGE semantic embedding written at store time.
inputs: POST /api/remember {kind, author, title, body, native?, repo?, run?}
outputs: journaled + embedded artifacts recallable by vector or text
parts.failure_mode: an unbound binding (no D1/Vectorize) must degrade honestly, not throw

parts.name: WRITE at task end
parts.essence: Distill the task to <=200 words — what was decided, learned, and what gap remains — and POST it fire-and-forget so it never blocks the lane.
outputs: one distilled artifact in the ocean
parts.failure_mode: unbounded dumping would turn the ocean into a log dump
parts.evidence: si-fleet/tidepool/README.md 'WRITE at task end, fire-and-forget, never blocks'

parts.name: READ at task start
parts.essence: Recall-prime the top 3 relevant artifacts into context: hybrid semantic recall with an honest text fallback, a recent mode when no query is given, and /api/recall/similar for neighbors of an artifact or a raw native vector.
outputs: top-3 artifacts primed into the working context
parts.failure_mode: silent semantic-only failure (the text fallback exists because embeddings can be empty)

parts.name: provenance discipline
parts.essence: Never secrets; every result carries author and ts; prefer recent; distrust unlabeled — the same rule as memory files, applied to the shared ocean.
parts.gate: a write without author/ts is distrusted by policy
parts.evidence: si-fleet/tidepool/README.md protocol bullets 'Never secrets', 'Every result carries author and ts'

parts.name: absence is information
parts.essence: If recall returns nothing, that emptiness is a finding: write the first stone — the protocol turns empty memory into an obligation to seed it.
outputs: the first artifact on that topic
parts.gate: empty recall obligates a first write
parts.failure_mode: treating empty recall as 'nothing to see' and moving on
parts.evidence: si-fleet/tidepool/README.md 'Absence is information — if recall returns nothing, write the first stone'

parts.name: honest degrade, never 502
parts.essence: Unbound bindings report themselves in /health and in route responses; the service degrades honestly instead of erroring — infrastructure that admits what it lacks.
parts.gate: the pool must never return 502; degradation is declared, not hidden
parts.failure_mode: a hard error page would hide which binding is missing
parts.evidence: si-fleet/tidepool/README.md 'Degrade honest, never 502 — unbound bindings report themselves in /health'

parts.name: privacy-preserving rate limit
parts.essence: 45/min/IP sliding window where the IP exists only as an fnv1a fingerprint — the meter works without storing identities.
parts.failure_mode: storing raw IPs would violate the never-secrets rule
parts.evidence: si-fleet/tidepool/README.md 'Rate limit: 45/min/IP sliding window, fnv1a(ip) fingerprints only'; smoke check '429s engage inside the window'

parts.name: JEV recall gate
parts.essence: Optional schema-bounded conscience on the recall path: typed surface/suppress/abstain with confidence, agreement mass sigma = sqrt(c_emb * c_jev) across two local witnesses, TIDEPOOL_JEV_FLOOR (default 0.5) refuses below-floor pairings as typed abstain; deterministic mock without an endpoint.
inputs: scored recall row + embedding confidence + JEV verdict
parts.gate: pairings below the floor refuse as a typed abstain; untyped JEV input fails closed
parts.failure_mode: malformed body / network error must fail closed to typed abstain (tested)

parts.name: quilt at the edge
parts.essence: quilt-cloudflare: the same cell model and YAML sheets persisted in D1, searchable via Vectorize, cached in KV, fan-out at the edge; /run loads a sheet, /cell/:id reads a cell.
outputs: a running Quilt engine per Workers deployment
parts.failure_mode: edge/state divergence if D1 persistence is skipped
parts.evidence: si-fleet/quilt-cloudflare/README.md 'The same cell model, the same YAML sheets...'; src/worker.ts, src/tide.ts, src/ocean.ts

parts.name: AI as cell kinds + router
parts.essence: @quilt/ai: 4 providers (zai, kimi, deepseek, cloudflare), 8 cell kinds, one uniform interface; the mermaid diagram's rule — 'the router spending tokens only when it must' — with budget.over as the router input.
parts.gate: router escalates to expensive providers only when the cheap path or budget says so
parts.failure_mode: indiscriminate premium-model calls burning the budget
parts.evidence: si-fleet/quilt-ai/README.md '4 providers. 8 cell kinds. 1 uniform interface.' + mermaid router diagram; src/providers/*.ts

parts.name: agent-as-sheet
parts.essence: quilt-agent: the agent IS a sheet — memory is value cells, tools are api cells, reasoning is program cells, goals are listener cells, conversation history is a growing value cell, the prompt is a formula over it.
inputs: YAML agent sheet (input.task, memory, tool.search, tool.llm, reasoning.prompt...)
outputs: an agent whose every capability is an inspectable cell
parts.failure_mode: hidden agent state outside cells breaks inspectability
parts.evidence: si-fleet/quilt-agent/README.md 'The agent is a sheet...' + examples/research-agent.yaml

parts.name: CANON.md identity headers
parts.essence: Each lane declares canon front-matter — mission, state, family, vessel, born_from, feeds, owed_by, canonical_docs, ledger, verified date — identity and debts as parseable metadata.
parts.failure_mode: a lane with no declared feeds/owed_by is uncoordinated by construction
parts.evidence: si-fleet/tidepool/CANON.md (canon: 1, mission, feeds: [quilt-studio, duke-lab], owed_by, verified: 2026-09-22)

parts.name: fully mocked offline test wall
parts.essence: tidepool's 18-check smoke + 13 node tests run with mocked D1/Vectorize/AI and deterministic embeddings — including fail-closed, floor refusal, and gate-off bit-identity checks — green with zero network.
parts.gate: gate-off responses must remain bit-identical to ungated ones
parts.failure_mode: an opt-in gate that silently changes default behavior
parts.evidence: si-fleet/tidepool/tests/tidepool.smoke.mjs, tests/jev.test.mjs; this lane's run: 18 passed + 13 pass, 0 fail

parts.name: polyformalism ports
parts.essence: One primitive (fnv1a) written in python, c, rust, plus polyform Cell in Haskell and bookkeeper in Mercury — the claim 'same semantics in every substrate' made executable.
parts.failure_mode: substrate-specific drift in the hash basis (the thing crab-traps depends on)

parts.name: deployability receipts
parts.essence: Every subproject ships its own deploy path: wrangler.toml bindings, DEPLOY.md steps, a committed dist/ worker bundle, MIT/Apache licenses — 'you can run this' is part of the artifact.
parts.failure_mode: docs that promise a deploy the repo cannot perform
parts.evidence: si-fleet/tidepool/worker/wrangler.toml; si-fleet/quilt-cloudflare/DEPLOY.md + dist/worker.js; package.json files present in each lane

layer_logic.0: substrate = five co-located lanes + a D1/Vectorize ocean whose records always name their author and time
layer_logic.1: mechanism = distill-then-recall over shared artifacts, a typed JEV conscience on recall, and one hash primitive proven in five languages
layer_logic.2: policy = honesty laws: never 502, absence obligates a first stone, no secrets, rate-limited fingerprints, canon headers declare debts
layer_logic.3: interface = the same cell model at the edge (Workers), as AI cells behind a budget router, and as the agent's own body
layer_logic.4: evidence = an offline mocked test wall (31 checks) plus per-lane deploy paths — infra that receipts its own honesty
